templates.name: Bull Call Spread
templates.description: Buy a call and sell a call at a higher strike, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Bull Put Spread
templates.description: Sell a put and buy a put at a lower strike, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Synthetic Long
templates.description: Buy a call and sell a put at the same strike and expiry; the combined payoff moves like the underlying.

templates.name: Bear Put Spread
templates.description: Buy a put and sell a put at a lower strike, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Bear Call Spread
templates.description: Sell a call and buy a call at a higher strike, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Synthetic Short
templates.description: Buy a put and sell a call at the same strike and expiry; the combined payoff moves opposite the underlying.

templates.name: Iron Condor
templates.description: Sell a put and a call at two different strikes, the put below the call, and buy a put and a call the same number of steps further out on each side, all the same expiry: a bull put spread plus a bear call spread.

templates.name: Iron Fly
templates.description: Sell a call and a put at the at-the-money strike, and buy a put and a call the same number of steps away on each side, all the same expiry.

templates.name: Straddle (Short)
templates.description: Sell a call and a put at the at-the-money strike, the same expiry.

templates.name: Strangle (Short)
templates.description: Sell an out-of-the-money call and an out-of-the-money put, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Jade Lizard
templates.description: Sell an out-of-the-money put, sell an out-of-the-money call and buy a call at a higher strike, all the same expiry; there is no upside breakeven when the combined credit exceeds the call spread's width.

templates.name: Straddle (Long)
templates.description: Buy a call and a put at the at-the-money strike, the same expiry.

templates.name: Strangle (Long)
templates.description: Buy an out-of-the-money call and an out-of-the-money put, both the same expiry.

templates.name: Reverse Iron Condor
templates.description: Buy a put and a call at two different strikes, the put below the call, and sell a put and a call the same number of steps further out on each side, all the same expiry.

templates.name: Covered Call
templates.description: Hold a futures position and sell an out-of-the-money call against it, the same expiry (this platform models "own the underlying" as a futures leg, ADR-041; no single-stock leg exists here).

templates.name: Cash-Secured Put
templates.description: Sell an out-of-the-money put, holding cash or margin against the full exposure; cash-settled at expiry (no shares are bought or delivered on NIFTY/SENSEX index options).

templates.name: Calendar Spread
templates.description: Sell a near-expiry call and buy a call at the same strike on a later expiry.

templates.name: Diagonal Spread
templates.description: Buy a call on a later expiry and sell a near-expiry call at a higher strike.

templates.name: Butterfly Spread
templates.description: Buy a call, sell two calls a number of strike steps above it, and buy a call the same number of steps above those, all the same expiry.

templates.name: Call Ratio Backspread
templates.description: Sell one call and buy two calls at a higher strike, all the same expiry.

templates.name: Put Ratio Backspread
templates.description: Sell one put and buy two puts at a lower strike, all the same expiry.
